name: naver_stored_summary_corrected
sql: SELECT payload->>'storeId' AS store_id,payload->>'date' AS date,payload->>'calculationVersion' AS calculation_version,payload->>'calculatedAt' AS calculated_at,payload->>'totalRevenue' AS total_revenue,payload->>'totalAdCost' AS ad_cost,payload->>'estimatedNetProfit' AS estimated_profit,payload->>'profitStatus' AS profit_status,payload->>'deliveryMargin' AS delivery_margin,payload->>'excludedOrderRevenue' AS excluded_order_revenue,payload->>'excludedAdCost' AS excluded_ad_cost FROM public.daily_store_summaries WHERE payload->>'date'>='2026-10-20' AND payload->>'date'<'2026-10-27' ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 30

name: naver_stored_profit_fingerprints
sql: SELECT payload->>'storeId' AS store_id,payload->>'date' AS date,payload->>'calculationVersion' AS calculation_version,count(*) AS rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE payload->>'costSnapshotId' IS NULL) AS null_cost_snapshot,count(*) FILTER(WHERE payload->>'mappingBasisHash' IS NULL) AS null_mapping_hash FROM public.daily_sales_unit_profits WHERE payload->>'date'>='2026-10-20' AND payload->>'date'<'2026-10-27' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 30
